sentences.text: For floating-rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals and sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges, and that applies to this case.
The home loan agreement says that on foreclosure or pre-payment, in full or in part, the borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding.
Because the applicable RBI-based direction for this case says no pre-payment charge may be levied, a clause that requires a 3% pre-payment charge would not comply with that direction.
